Missions (Data Sync Feeds) are managed withing Mission Manager inside takserver UI.

Mission Manager can be found at https://tak.server.fi:8443/Marti/MissionManager.html

Managing Missions

Managing the Missions (Data Sync - Feeds) is done withing Takserver or with TAK Products in Data Sync tool. For Managing the Missions the user need either Owner or Write user rights for the feed. If you want to change your user rights check Change User Rights

Create a Mission

Administrators (Admin users) can create new missions in the Takserver Mission Manager view. Select + ADD and fill in the desired settings for the feed.

If the defaultRole is set to ReadOnly, you must assign one or more users to the Owner and/or ReadWrite roles. See Change User Rights for instructions.

The main settings for a mission are:

  • Name
  • Optional Password
  • defaultRole
  • Groups

The defaultRole defines the default user permissions for users who subscribe to the feed: ReadOnly, ReadWrite, Owner, etc.

The Groups setting defines which Takserver groups can see the feed and are able to subscribe to it.

Delete Mission / Archive

Deleting Missions is done with selecting the feeds and choosing Delete. The deleted feeds are kept in the Archived Missions so the data hasn't been removed from the server.

Edit Mission

Editing mission via takserver is done from the Mission Manager, choose the feeds that are desired to change and change the settings. Select Save and Close after the changes are done.

Changing User Rights

If the RECON feed needs to be ReadOnly for regular users, at least one administrator must be assigned the Owner role for the feed so they can manage it.

To assign a user the Owner role through Takserver:

  1. Temporarily set the mission's defaultRole to Owner
  2. Have the desired user subscribe to the feed → they will receive Owner rights ( Example one command post user)
  3. Once all required users have the appropriate roles, you may return the defaultRole setting to the desired value for other users

Owner users can, withing the Data Sync plugin:

  • change other users' roles
  • manage users by inviting them to the mission or removing them from it

Changing roles is done in the feed settings under the Active Members menu using the key icon.
